# Pliego

> MADFAM's open-source (AGPL-3.0-only) platform for sheet hyperobjects: origami, kirigami,
> papercut, pop-up and paper engineering, book structures and interactive paper dioramas.
> Parametric and fabricable (cut, score and fold files), simulated with real paper physics.
> Status: incubating; built in the open, not deployed; see docs/HONEST_STATUS.md.

Boundary: public repository. Operational detail lives in MADFAM's private ops repository under the
repo-boundary contract (docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md).

## Invariants

- The crease pattern is the source; every 3-D state is derived from the flat sheet and its fold program.
- Sheet documents are FOLD 1.2 plus a `pliego:` namespace; the kernel writes them byte-stable.
- The engine replays bit-exactly with a pinned time step; paper physics comes from stock cards.
- Units: mm, degrees, grams, seconds. No solid modeling here: hardware is a `hardware_ref` to Yantra4D.
- Identity is Janua (RS256 via JWKS, audience `pliego-api`). LLMs only through the Selva gateway.
- No prices, no direct machine dispatch: quotes through Cotiza, fabrication through Pravara MES.

## Code

- `packages/kernel/`: pliego-kernel, Python standard library only
- `packages/engine/`: the physics engine, JavaScript ES modules, zero dependencies
- `packages/schemas/`: sheet-document and stock-card JSON Schemas
- `apps/web/`, `apps/api/`: landing and studio; Flask API (`/api/v1`, `/health`, `/ready`)
- `projects/`: the sheet-hyperobjects commons (git submodule, pinned)
